AI Automation Agency Builder v1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Launch automation agencies by finding and scoring businesses overwhelmed by manual work using data from LinkedIn, Google Maps, and job boards.
- Detect specific workflows causing time loss, calculate automation ROI, and generate tailored automation audit reports for each prospect.
- Auto-create a complete agency service menu with pricing and deliver a custom client pitch video via InVideo AI.
- Powered by Apify for scraping, InVideo AI for videos, and Claude AI for workflow analysis, audit generation, and pricing.
- Designed for freelancers, no-code specialists, and agency builders seeking a scalable service business with high client conversion.
